title: Afrobeats × AI Producer
script: Our ancestors created talking drums that could send messages across villages. Today? AI dey help us remix that same energy for the whole world. From Lagos to London, African music dey use technology to reach ears wey nobody fit imagine before. This na Afro-futurism – where tradition meet innovation, and Nigeria dey lead the way!
caption:
From talking drums to AI beats – African innovation never stop. 🥁✨

Our ancestors were the first sound engineers. Now we dey take that legacy global with technology.

Which AI music tool you dey use? Drop am below! 👇🏾
